description: Source: Chapter II, Fire Talisman. Obtain talisman paper to discover the original recipe.
Use: one 600 + 3x attack hit within 4.5 blocks of the aim point, ignites for 8 seconds.
Survival use consumes one. Press R for recipes, or U on talisman paper for available charms.
Source: Chapter II, Thunder Talisman and the Edict build guide; no new use gate.
Use: one 800 + 4x attack hit within 5 blocks. Three bolts are visual; Slowness II for 8s and Weakness II for 5s.
Survival use consumes one. Press R for recipes, or U on talisman paper for available charms.
Optional Wind Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
Use: 200 + 2x attack and knockback around you; Speed III, Slow Falling and Jump Boost II for 45s.

Optional Stealth Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
Use: Invisibility, Speed II and Night Vision for 60s; clear current mob aggro within 16 blocks.

Source: main journey, Prepare Your Return → Return Talisman. Prepare before departure.
